In this video, we take a look at the Deepa Jewellers Limited IPO, covering key things investors need to know about the company and the issue. We begin with a business overview, including the company's business model, revenue model and geographical presence, followed by an analysis of the jewellery industry. We then look at the company's financial performance and KPIs, compare it with its peers, evaluate its valuation, and discuss the major risks and litigations associated with the business. Finally, we break down the IPO details to help you understand the issue better.
